harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the provided ed25519 public key for SSH access, locked its local password, and confirmed/enforced sshd-wide key-based authentication (PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1 natively, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified sshd and the opsadmin configuration recovered intact post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 baseline: OS (Ubuntu 16.04), confirmed opsadmin did not exist, and reviewed existing sshd_config auth directives
Created opsadmin user, installed the given ed25519 public key into ~/.ssh/authorized_keys with correct ownership/permissions (700/600), and locked opsadmin's password (passwd -l)
Set/reaffirmed sshd_config: PasswordAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no; validated config with sshd -t and restarted ssh service
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, sshd active status, opsadmin/key state, port 22 listener
Issued native reboot on node1 with an acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned, confirming a changed boot_id as proof of actual restart
Verified post-restart recovery: sshd active/valid config, key-only auth settings intact, opsadmin account/key/password-lock persisted, port 22 listening

evidence.requirement: opsadmin created with the specified public key installed for SSH access
evidence.summary: Baseline showed opsadmin missing; follow-up command created opsadmin, wrote the exact ed25519 key to authorized_keys with 600 perms, and confirmed via id/cat/passwd -S

evidence.requirement: Key-based SSH authentication required (password auth disabled, pubkey auth enabled)
evidence.summary: sshd_config set/validated with PasswordAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no; sshd -t passed; settings confirmed both before and after restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id (e4e401d2...), uptime, active sshd, opsadmin/key state, and listening port 22 prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command returned an ack ('reboot scheduled, ack returned') before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity proving an actual restart
evidence.summary: Connection refused during reboot window, then exec access returned with boot_id changed from e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229 to ee3dd910-9741-466e-b081-9f9cc860f97e

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required services/data
evidence.summary: Post-reboot check confirmed sshd active with valid config, key-only auth directives intact, opsadmin user/key/password-lock persisted, and port 22 listening
